+# Spec for issue 1: the app README has no "run it" section
+
+## Outcome
+
+A volunteer who opens `README.md` can start the web page, run the desk CLI and run the tests by
+copying commands from one short section.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- The system shall have a section in `README.md` whose heading is "Run it".
+- Where the "Run it" section lists how to start the web page, the system shall show the command `bun src/server.ts`.
+- Where the "Run it" section lists how to run the desk CLI, the system shall show a command that starts with `bun src/desk.ts`.
+- Where the "Run it" section lists how to run the tests, the system shall show the command `bun test`.
+- If a command in the "Run it" section names a file under `src/`, the system shall point at a file that exists.
+
+## Must not change
+
+- Everything under `src/`, including `src/auth/`.
+- The existing tests under `tests/`.
+- The intro and the "Folders" table in `README.md`.
+- `package.json`.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- New npm scripts, such as `start` or `desk`.
+- Changing how the web page or the desk CLI behave.
+- Documenting the API, the seed data or the gate.
+
+## Done when
+
+- `bun test tests` passes, including the new tests in `tests/readme/run-it.test.ts`.
+- `bun run gate` exits 0.
diff --git a/tests/readme/run-it.test.ts b/tests/readme/run-it.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f526dbe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/readme/run-it.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
+import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+
+const readme = readFileSync("README.md", "utf8");
+
+function runItSection(): string {
+  const start = readme.search(/^##\s+Run it\s*$/m);
+  if (start === -1) {
+    return "";
+  }
+  const rest = readme.slice(start).replace(/^##\s+Run it\s*$/m, "");
+  const next = rest.search(/^##\s/m);
+  if (next === -1) {
+    return rest;
+  }
+  return rest.slice(0, next);
+}
+
+test("README has a Run it section", () => {
+  expect(runItSection().trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+});
+
+test("Run it shows how to start the web page", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).toContain("bun src/server.ts");
+});
+
+test("Run it shows how to run the desk CLI", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).toMatch(/bun src\/desk\.ts \S+/);
+});
+
+test("Run it shows how to run the tests", () => {
+  expect(runItSection()).toMatch(/bun test\b/);
+});
+
+test("every src file named in Run it exists", () => {
+  const section = runItSection();
+  const named = [...section.matchAll(/bun (src\/[\w./-]+\.ts)/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
+  expect(named.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  for (const file of named) {
+    expect(existsSync(file)).toBe(true);
+  }
+});
# Spec for issue 1: the app README has no "run it" section

## Outcome

A volunteer who opens `README.md` can start the web page, run the desk CLI and run the tests by
copying commands from one short section.

## Requirements

- The system shall have a section in `README.md` whose heading is "Run it".
- Where the "Run it" section lists how to start the web page, the system shall show the command `bun src/server.ts`.
- Where the "Run it" section lists how to run the desk CLI, the system shall show a command that starts with `bun src/desk.ts`.
- Where the "Run it" section lists how to run the tests, the system shall show the command `bun test`.
- If a command in the "Run it" section names a file under `src/`, the system shall point at a file that exists.

## Must not change

- Everything under `src/`, including `src/auth/`.
- The existing tests under `tests/`.
- The intro and the "Folders" table in `README.md`.
- `package.json`.

## Out of scope

- New npm scripts, such as `start` or `desk`.
- Changing how the web page or the desk CLI behave.
- Documenting the API, the seed data or the gate.

## Done when

- `bun test tests` passes, including the new tests in `tests/readme/run-it.test.ts`.
- `bun run gate` exits 0.
